title.narrative: In 2024 a total of 19,953 additional people (10,376 men, 9,577 women) in 46 rural communities gained access to basic sanitation and basic hygiene through a UNICEF-supported programme. Among them, 17,958 people were able to access climate-resilient services and 11,972 have access to safely managed sanitation services.
